hypotheses.C1_late_empirical_concentration: Layer 17 has an empirical centered-write top-four variance fraction at least 0.10 above layers 0 and 8 on both discovery and evaluation.
hypotheses.C2_late_gaussian_concentration: At full width, layer 17 has a centered Gaussian-moment top-four fraction at least 0.10 above layers 0 and 8.
hypotheses.C3_gaussian_subspace_alignment: At full width, the mean top-four canonical cosine between the Gaussian-moment and empirical write subspaces is at least 0.70 at every layer.
hypotheses.C4_gaussian_covariance_prediction: At full width, Gaussian-moment versus empirical covariance cosine is at least 0.80 at every layer.
hypotheses.C5_empirical_subspace_transfer: At every layer, discovery top-four write PCs capture at least 90% as much evaluation variance as evaluation's own top four PCs.
hypotheses.C6_mean_cross_term_matters: At some layer, omitting the mean-state linear cross term reduces covariance cosine by at least 0.10.
